items.title: The Mor functor from a finite free affine scheme into an affine scheme is representable by an affine scheme
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.work: Stacks Project, chapter more-morphisms.tex (More on Morphisms)
items.source_version: Stacks Project source tree, file more-morphisms.tex, corpus local snapshot 20261011
items.difficulty_reason: Representability is proved by exhibiting the representing object explicitly and then checking the universal property on affine test schemes. The construction picks a finite basis e_1,...,e_m of Gamma(Z,O_Z) over R, a presentation of Gamma(X,O_X) by generators and relations, adjoins one variable a_{ij} per generator-and-basis-index pair, pushes the relations f_k through the resulting map Psi, and cuts out by the ideal J generated by all coefficients c_{kj} of Psi(f_k) along the basis. The load-bearing points are that the universal map b_univ factors through Gamma(X,O_X) and that the induced map W(T) -> Mor_S(Z,X)(T) is a bijection on affine T, which is where the finite-freeness of Gamma(Z,O_Z) over R is used. Retained author proof at lines 20107-20168.
